headline: Economic Development Commission hears presentations on Simpson Court Mural and development team roles, plus committee and manufacturing roundtable reports.
summary: The meeting includes guest presentations on a Simpson Court mural update and on the town's economic development team roles and strategic planning. Committee reports, an incentives review, and a manufacturing roundtable update will also be covered.
items: Guest Presentation: Joe Mirra & Tim Ryan - Simpson Court Mural update
Guest Presentation: Dale Kroop, REX Development - 'On the Ground - Roles and responsibilities of the Town's economic development team' & strategic planning for development
Old Business: Review current incentives and Next Steps
location: Town Hall, Room 315, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, CT 06492
